observations: The function `access` takes a single parameter `check` and is declared async.
Line 2 calls `check()` without `await`, so the returned Promise is used directly as the condition.
A Promise object is always truthy, so the `if` branch is taken regardless of the resolved boolean value.
The behavior contract states `check` is async and resolves to a boolean, allowing only when it resolves true.
Probe p1 passes `async () => false`; probe p2 passes `async () => true`; both would take the same branch under the current code.
The authorization decision is made solely by the truthiness of the unawaited call result, not by the resolved value.
